scripts.build:component: cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && wasm-tools component new target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/imaging.wasm -o imaging.wasm
scripts.build:bindings: rm -rf dist && jco transpile imaging.wasm -o dist
scripts.build:worker: rm -rf worker/dist && jco transpile thumbnailer.wasm -o worker/dist --instantiation async && node scripts/worker-modules.mjs
scripts.build:native: cd bench/native && cargo build --release && node ../../scripts/copy-native.mjs target/release ../imaging.node
scripts.build:native:cpu: cd bench/native && RUSTFLAGS='-C target-cpu=native' cargo build --release --target-dir target/cpu-native && node ../../scripts/copy-native.mjs target/cpu-native/release ../imaging.cpu.node
scripts.build:coldopen: cd coldopen/native-hello && rm -f native-hello-1.0.0.tgz && npm pack
scripts.build:evil: cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --features evil --target-dir target/evil && wasm-tools component new target/evil/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/imaging.wasm -o imaging.evil.wasm && rm -rf evil/dist && jco transpile imaging.evil.wasm -o evil/dist --name imaging && cd bench/native && cargo build --release --features evil --target-dir target/evil && node ../../scripts/copy-native.mjs target/evil/release ../imaging.evil.node
